source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of modifying lists (PDF 51).

blocks.text: List ka item badalne ke liye us ke index se usay pakrein aur nayi value assign kar dein (rakh dein). Misaal: pehla item "Orange" kar dein aur naya phal "Pineapple" jor dein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"]": teen phalon ki list.
"fruits [0] = "Orange"": index 0 wala item (Mango) hata kar us ki jagah "Orange" rakh diya; list mutable (badli ja sakne wali) hai, is liye yeh mumkin hai.
"fruits.append("Pineapple")": "Pineapple" list ke aakhir mein jur jata hai.
"print(fruits)": badli hui list print hoti hai. Aakhri line sirf comment hai.
Output: ['Orange', 'Apple', 'Banana', 'Pineapple']
Khud try karein: fruits [0] ki jagah fruits [2] likh kar Run karein: ab Banana badlega aur ['Mango', 'Apple', 'Orange', 'Pineapple'] aayega.

blocks.prompt: In lines ke baad fruits mein kitni cheezein hain aur fruits[-1] kya hai?

items: list[index] = nayi value se badlein; append() se aakhir mein jorein.
